video.title: Laziest Way to Make Money with AI (If You're Broke)

summary: George McConnell, an e-commerce YouTuber, shows how to sell AI-designed personalised star map posters through print on demand. He validates demand with Everbee on Etsy and Amazon sales counts, uses a three-step ChatGPT prompt to compute the real visible constellations for a date and place and generate a design, upscales it, and lists it through Gelato connected to Etsy, Amazon or Shopify. He claims it can be set up within an hour; no first-hand sales figures for this product are given.

speakers.name: George McConnell
speakers.description: E-commerce YouTuber; says he has sold 800,000+ products and worked on marketing for Samsung and Shark

ideas.name: AI-generated personalised star map posters via print on demand
ideas.one_liner: Sell personalised star constellation posters for a birth or wedding date/location, designed with ChatGPT and fulfilled by Gelato print on demand on Etsy/Amazon/Shopify.
ideas.business_model: One-off product sales with print-on-demand fulfilment; margin = retail price minus Gelato base cost
ideas.customer: Couples and gift buyers wanting a personalised keepsake for a wedding, proposal or birth
ideas.problem: Existing star map products look generic ('just a circle and their name') yet sell in volume
ideas.offer: Accurate, attractive personalised night-sky poster showing the real constellations visible at the given date, time and location, in poster, canvas, acrylic or metal

pricing.model: Per-unit retail sale; competitor retail from $39 to hundreds
pricing.notes: Retail price for his own store not stated; Gelato figures are production costs.

acquisition_channels.details: List on Etsy and Amazon (validated demand there via Everbee and Amazon 'bought in past month' counts); Gelato also connects to TikTok Shop, Shopify, WooCommerce, Wix.

quote.text: They connect to everything. Shopify, WooCommerce, Wix, Etsy, TikTok Shop, and amazon.com
quote.speaker: George McConnell

ideas.delivery: Customer enters names, date and location via the personalisation option; seller runs a ChatGPT prompt to compute visible constellations and generate the design, upscales it (ARTD), uploads to Gelato which prints and ships.
unit_economics_claims: Competitor street-sign product: 372 sales in 3 months, $7,400
Gelato 24x36 framed poster $87 cost; 8x12 $23 ($16 with Gelato Plus)
ideas.startup_cost: Low (ChatGPT subscription, optional Gelato Plus); not stated exactly
ideas.time_to_first_revenue: Claimed same day ('within an hour you can have this up and running')

acquisition.how: Marketplace listings bring inbound buyers; listing creation can be agent-driven.

delivery.how: Design generation per order can be scripted with an image model API plus upscaler and Gelato API; quality check advisable.

support.how: Order queries and reprints via agent with human approval.

uk_applicability.notes: Etsy, Amazon UK and Gelato (which has UK/EU print partners) all operate in the UK.

risks: Many competitors with thousands of reviews
AI constellation accuracy may be wrong; customer complaints
Etsy/Amazon fees and ad costs not discussed

tactics.name: Validate a personalised product across Etsy and Amazon
steps: Use Everbee to find top-selling personalised products on Etsy
Check Amazon for consistent sales (e.g. '600 bought in past month')
Look for categories where existing designs look poor so better design wins

quote.text: The next thing to do is to look at Amazon. Is Amazon selling it and does it sell consistently?
quote.speaker: George McConnell

tactics.name: Three-step ChatGPT star map prompt
steps: Ask for a print-ready personalised star map poster with title, names, date, time and location
Step 1: determine the real prominent constellations visible from that location and time, only those above the horizon
Step 2: identify and label the visible constellations
Step 3: return final facts, poster text and a reusable image prompt; run the prompt to generate the art

quote.text: determine the actual prominent constellation visible from the provided location on the provided day and time
quote.speaker: George McConnell

tactics.name: Upscale before printing and fulfil via Gelato
steps: Upscale the image (he uses ARTD) so large prints are not grainy
In Gelato choose product (fine art poster, framed, 24x36), upload design, preview
One-click connect Gelato to Etsy/Shopify/Amazon and enable the personalisation option for name, date, location

quote.text: make sure that you're using a good upscaler no matter what. Upscale before you upload it
quote.speaker: George McConnell
